channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Saiba quem é Flávio Roscoe, candidato ao governo de Minas pelo PL
item.description: Flávio Roscoe, former president of Fiemg and textile industry businessman, was announced as the PL candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, following internal party negotiations and the withdrawal of Cleitinho Azevedo from the Republicans. At 51, with a history background and experience at Grupo Colortextil, he is backed by Flávio Bolsonaro and noted for his good relations with federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira.

item.title: Escolha de Gaspar para vice de Flávio não empolgou a Faria Lima
item.description: The selection of federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate failed to excite Faria Lima, which views the pick as a missed opportunity to broaden the ticket's electoral appeal, particularly by not choosing a woman from another party to reduce female voter resistance to Bolsonarismo. A rape of a vulnerable person allegation against Gaspar, with the PF requesting an STF investigation, raised fears of campaign contamination, despite his denial and claims of political persecution tied to his INSS CPI work. While Faria Lima acknowledges positives — his Northeastern roots, INSS CPI role, and tough-on-crime/anti-corruption rhetoric — it concludes the choice fell short of market expectations for electoral gain.

item.title: ‘Não é uma eleição confortável para Lula’, diz CEO do Ideia sobre nova pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: The Meio/Ideia poll shows Lula leading with 43% in the first round and 48.5% in a potential runoff, compared to 35% and 43% for Flávio Bolsonaro. The race is described as crystallized due to strong polarization, with 66% of voters already decided and little room for alternative candidates. Despite the lead, Ideia CEO Cila Schulman states it is not a comfortable election for the incumbent, as the outcome will be tight and corruption has returned as a top voter concern.

item.title: Nikolas comemora escolha por Roscoe: "Flávio em MG e Flávio no Brasil"
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) celebrated the confirmation of Flávio Roscoe, former president of Fiemg, as the PL's candidate for governor of Minas Gerais in the 2026 elections. The decision followed the failure of negotiations to have Senator Cleitinho (Republicanos) as the party's nominee, which left him without a party. Roscoe, who had resigned from Fiemg and joined the PL, said the party tried to make Cleitinho's candidacy viable, but after over 120 days of waiting, opted to launch its own ticket, positioning itself as Flávio Bolsonaro's slate in MG.

item.title: Atitude irresponsável, diz Lula após revogação de visto de embaixadora
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva condemned the revocation of Brazilian Ambassador Maria Luiza Ribeiro Viotti's U.S. visa by the Trump administration as irresponsible and irresponsible, and disrespectful to Brazil's 203-year diplomatic tradition. He stressed that the U.S. has not sent an ambassador to Brazil in over a year and warned against foreign interference in Brazil's upcoming October elections.

item.title: Escolha de Gaspar atesta que Flávio é incapaz de ampliar base, diz Jardim
item.description: Deputy Arnaldo Jardim (Cidadania-SP) criticized the selection of Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) running mate as proof of the candidate's inability to broaden his base, following rejections from Podemos, Republicans, and the União Brasil/PP federation. While praising Gaspar as a qualified legislator, Jardim argued the choice reflects the PL's isolation. He announced his support for Ronaldo Caiado's (PSD) presidential campaign, stating Caiado can break Brazil's extreme polarization.

item.title: Medidas do governo não afetam metas fiscais, diz secretário do Planejamento
item.description: The executive secretary of the Ministry of Planning and Budget, Guilherme Mello, stated that the government's economic measures in 2026 have a positive impact on the economy without compromising fiscal targets or increasing inflation. He rebutted claims that the policies constitute an 'electoral goodies package,' arguing that costs are transparent in the budget and that rising inflation expectations stem from climatic, international shocks, fuel prices, global inflation, and inertia — not from demand stimulus.

item.title: ANÁLISE: Escolha de Alfredo Gaspar como vice de Flávio Bolsonaro beneficia Lira em Alagoas
item.description: The selection of Alfredo Gaspar as Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate removes him from the Senate race in Alagoas, directly benefiting Arthur Lira (PP-AL), who no longer faces his main conservative rival for the Senate seat. This shift also opens the door for a potential reconciliation between Lira and former Maceió mayor JHC (PSDB), whose earlier rift stemmed from competing for senatorial space. Although Lira has not publicly confirmed his role, allies and adversaries say he was instrumental in crafting a solution that strengthens his candidacy and eases political tensions in the state.

item.title: Flávio e Marinho tinham escolhido Gaspar há 6 meses, diz Valdemar
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, revealed that Flávio Bolsonaro and Senator Rogério Marinho had selected Deputy Alfredo Gaspar as their presidential running mate six months prior, keeping the decision secret to prevent leaks. Although Gaspar was not initially informed, the choice remained confidential until the official announcement, contradicting earlier speculation about a potential female vice-presidential pick.

item.title: Lula diz que espera El Niño 'calmo' e brinca: 'Se vier bravo, eu estou fervendo'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that the federal government is preparing to face the possible effects of El Niño, a climate phenomenon linked to droughts and floods. He joked that he hopes El Niño comes 'calm', because if it comes 'angry', he will be 'boiling', but emphasized the need to pray for divine help to avoid major damages to Brazil. Lula mentioned a meeting with 24 ministers, reinforcement of firefighting resources, expansion of brigadists, actions by Civil Defense and health sectors, and the purchase of 350,000 basic food baskets for affected populations.

item.title: Portinho diz que Gaspar era consenso entre Flávio e Rogério
item.description: Senator Carlos Portinho (PL-RJ) revealed that the selection of Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as the vice-presidential candidate on the Bolsonarist ticket for 2026 was agreed upon by Flávio Bolsonaro and Senator Rogério Marinho about six months ago, kept confidential until now. The decision was made between the two PL leaders from Rio de Janeiro and Rio Grande do Norte, respectively, before being made public.

item.title: Lula chama revogação de visto de embaixadora de “irresponsável e impensada”
item.description: President Lula condemned the U.S. government's revocation of the Brazilian ambassador's visa as 'irresponsible and thoughtless', calling it a baseless retaliation for delays in approving the U.S. nominee to Brasil. He stated he will not receive any U.S. ambassadors in Brazil until after the 2026 elections, demanding mutual respect, and supported Itamaraty's denial of visas to two U.S. officials seeking to monitor Brazil's electoral process, which Brasil views as unacceptable interference.

item.title: Gaspar reforça guinada de Flávio para endurecer embate com Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro selected Alfredo Gaspar as his vice-presidential running mate for the 2026 presidential race, signaling a strategic shift toward hardening rhetoric against President Lula after failed attempts to build a coalition with Centrist parties. Gaspar, a federal deputy from PL-AL, gained national prominence as rapporteur of the INSS Parliamentary Inquiry Committee (CPMI), where he called for the indictment of Lulinha, and is viewed by the campaign as a credible figure on security and pensions, representing the Northeast and core Bolsonarist values.

item.title: Vice de Flávio ganhou 400 mil seguidores no Instagram com CPMI do INSS
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar, running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro, saw a 157.9% increase in Instagram followers between August 2025 and March 2026, reaching 746,000 after being announced as the vice-presidential candidate. His rise is tied to his role as rapporteur of the INSS CPMI, which investigated improper deductions from retirees’ benefits and recommended the indictment of 216 individuals, including Fábio Luís Lula da Silva. Gaspar’s selection aims to counter Lula’s influence in the Northeast and introduce corruption allegations against the president’s family.

item.title: Vice de Flávio Bolsonaro entrou na política pelas mãos dos Calheiros e usou CPI para desgastar Lula
item.description: Federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), chosen by Flávio Bolsonaro as his vice-presidential running mate in the 2026 ticket after centrist parties rejected a coalition, entered politics through the influence of the Calheiros family (MDB), a traditional ally of President Lula. Despite this background, Gaspar has used his role in parliamentary inquiry committees (CPIs) to attack the Lula government, creating a contrast between his past alliances with the centrão and his current radical opposition stance.

item.title: TRE de São Paulo forma maioria para manter Pablo Marçal inelegível
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court (TRE-SP) formed a majority to maintain the ineligibility of businessman and influencer Pablo Marçal until 2032, blocking his Senate candidacy in the state. The ruling was issued in a virtual plenary session and remains subject to appeal at the Superior Electoral Court (TSE).

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro anuncia ex-presidente da Fiemg Flávio Roscoe como candidato do PL ao governo de MG
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro announced businessman Flávio Roscoe, former president of Fiemg, as the PL's candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, after Republicans ruled out Cleitinho Azevedo's candidacy. Roscoe was selected due to his close ties with Bolsonaro and his prior collaboration on the senator's presidential government plan, defeating internal rival Vittorio Medioli, backed by the party's ideological wing.

item.title: Quem é Alfredo Gaspar, anunciado como vice de Flávio Bolsonaro na disputa à Presidência da República
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced Alfredo Gaspar as his running mate for the 2026 presidential race. Gaspar, a federal deputy from PL-Alagoas, is a former prosecutor, public security secretary, and attorney general of Alagoas, and ran unsuccessfully for mayor of Maceió in 2020. His career includes stints in the MDB and the Alagoas Public Ministry, marked by conflicts over the incompatibility between prosecutorial roles and executive office.

item.title: A reação de Lula à revogação de visto de embaixadora brasileira nos EUA
item.description: President Lula criticized the revocation of the visa of Brazil's ambassador to the U.S., Maria Luiza Ribeiro Viotti, as an irresponsible and unnecessary move, highlighting the 203 years of diplomatic relations between the two countries. He stated the measure was a retaliation for Brazil not granting diplomatic approval for Daniel Perez to assume the U.S. embassy in Brazil, and reiterated he will not receive ambassadors until after the 2026 elections. Lula also said the U.S. did not give importance to Brazil by leaving the embassy vacant for a year and a half under the Trump administration.

item.title: PL lança candidatura própria de Flávio Roscoe em Minas
item.description: The Liberal Party announced Flávio Roscoe, former president of Fiemg, as its candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, after failed negotiations with Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) and Marcelo Aro (PP). The announcement was made in a video featuring Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, expressing hope for a strong ticket amid internal divisions on the right in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Vice de Flavio é investigado por estupro de vulnerável e desvio de R$ 6 milhões em emendas
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), announced as the running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 Brazilian elections, is under investigation by the STF for rape of a vulnerable person and also faces a probe into the alleged misappropriation of R$6 million in parliamentary amendments. The allegations raise serious concerns about the moral and administrative integrity of the Bolsonaro-backed ticket. The case could significantly affect the campaign and public perception of the alliance.

item.title: Marcola deixa campanha de Lula após PF descobrir pagamento feito a ele por lobista amiga de Lulinha
item.description: Former chief of staff to Lula, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), resigned from the president's re-election campaign after the Federal Police uncovered a R$ 249,000 payment from Roberta Luchsinger, a lobbyist and friend of Lulinha. Marcola stated the amount was repayment of a private loan and denied any wrongdoing. His departure aims to prevent the scandal from affecting Lula's re-election bid.

item.title: Mauro Vieira chama fala de Milei de agressiva ao justificar rebaixamento das relações: 'Questão ideológica é secundária'
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira justified the downgrading of diplomatic relations with Argentina as a response to 'insults and aggressions' by President Javier Milei against Brazil and its institutions, stating that ideological motives are secondary. The move limits Argentina's representation to a chargé d'affaires in Brasília and keeps Brazil's ambassador in Buenos Aires in Brazil for now. Argentina accused Brazil of acting on ideological grounds but said it would not take retaliatory measures.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre se reúnem em jantar promovido por Moraes após mais de 3 meses de distanciamento
item.description: Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre met at a dinner hosted by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes after over three months of estrangement, stemming from the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' STF nomination. During the meeting, Lula inquired about the PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule, and Alcolumbre said it would not be voted on until after the October elections. Both sides view the dinner as a first step toward institutional rapprochement.

item.title: “Casamento da rachadinha com o orçamento secreto”, diz Boulos sobre chapa de Flávio
item.description: Guilherme Boulos criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket, saying it represents the 'marriage of kickbacks with the secret budget,' referring to accusations against vice-presidential candidate Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), former rapporteur of the INSS CPMI. Boulos linked Gaspar’s selection to corruption and discreet use of public funds. The Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RN) ticket will challenge President Lula (PT) in the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Saiba quem é Alfredo Gaspar, vice de Flávio na disputa à Presidência
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) announced Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as his running mate for the 2026 presidential ticket, following months of negotiations and after abandoning plans to select a female candidate to reduce female voter rejection. Gaspar, a federal deputy and former prosecutor with 24 years of experience in fighting organized crime and corruption, had just confirmed his Senate candidacy in Alagoas the day before the announcement. He broke with the Calheiros political clan in 2022, moved from MDB to União Brasil and then to PL, and led the INSS Parliamentary Inquiry Committee (CPMI) in 2025, focusing on investigations into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva.

item.title: Lula chama revogação de visto de embaixadora brasileira de atitude 'irresponsável' e cobra respeito dos EUA
item.description: President Lula criticized the U.S. government's revocation of the diplomatic visa for Brazil's ambassador to Washington, Maria Luiza Ribeiro Viotti, calling it 'irresponsible' and stressing that Brazil demands respect in bilateral relations. He defended Itamaraty's decision to deny visas to U.S. officials seeking to monitor Brazil's electronic voting system and stated he will not receive foreign ambassadors until after the October elections.

item.title: Para tentar encerrar greve, Tarcísio promete projeto de lei que prevê garantia de emprego a trabalhadores das linhas 11, 12 e 13 dos trens de SP
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas announced he will send a bill to Alesp guaranteeing job security for CPTM workers on lines 11, 12, and 13, conditional on the resumption of peak-hour operations. The strike, which began Tuesday, was driven by workers' demand for a written commitment from the São Paulo government to preserve the jobs of 4,700 employees after the lines returned to state management following a brief private concession.

item.title: PL já alinhou discurso sobre ausência de mulher na chapa de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign has prepared talking points to counter criticism over the absence of a woman on their 'pure-blood' presidential ticket, after months of stating he wanted a woman as his running mate. Despite this, he announced today that deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) will be his vice-presidential candidate, keeping the ticket all-male. The strategy aims to minimize the impact of lacking female representation in the 2026 race.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre se reúnem em jantar com ministros do STF
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Congress President Davi Alcolumbre met for a dinner after months of no contact, signaling a political reconciliation effort. The meeting was facilitated by Supreme Court Justices Alexandre de Moraes and Cristiano Zanin, with other STF ministers also in attendance. The gathering reflects an attempt to ease institutional tensions and restore dialogue between the Executive and Legislative branches.

item.title: A indireta de Flávio a Alckmin, ao anunciar seu vice
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Geraldo Alckmin when announcing his running mate, Alfredo Gaspar, implying that Alckmin 'returns to the scene of the crime' by supporting Lula after previously accusing him of 'destroying Brazil' in 2017. The jab references Alckmin's past statement as a tucano, now reversed as he joins Lula's ticket.

item.title: Quem é Alfredo Gaspar, escolhido vice na chapa de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal Deputy Alfredo Gaspar has been chosen as the vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) ticket for the 2026 elections. Gaspar, who joined the PL in March 2024, is known for serving as rapporteur of the INSS CPI, which investigated fraud in the National Institute of Social Security. His nomination strengthens Bolsonaro's strategy of forming a pure-blood Bolsonarist ticket.

item.title: Ao escolher Alfredo Gaspar, Flávio aposta em combate à corrupção, não em economia, para a vice
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro selected Alfredo Gaspar as his running mate, prioritizing anti-corruption credentials over economic expertise. Gaspar, a former prosecutor and rapporteur of the INSS CPMI, gained national prominence for investigating pension fraud and financial crimes, but lacks experience in economic policy or congressional negotiations for structural reforms. The choice signals that the campaign believes anti-corruption rhetoric will mobilize more voters than selecting a vice president capable of reassuring financial markets.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro anuncia Alfredo Gaspar como seu vice na chapa à presidência
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro announced federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-BA) as his vice-presidential running mate for the 2026 presidential ticket. The announcement was made during a PL party meeting in Brasília, broadcast on the senator's social media, after weeks of uncertainty. The ticket is described as 'pure blood,' aligned with other right-wing candidates.

item.title: Alfredo Gaspar será o candidato a vice-presidente na chapa de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro has nominated Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as his vice-presidential running mate for the 2026 election, following failed attempts to form alliances with centrist parties. The decision reflects the PL's political isolation after Republicans, Brazil Union and Podemos declared neutrality. Gaspar, who served as rapporteur of the INSS scandal CPMI, was chosen over alternatives including a female candidate and Rogério Marinho, reinforcing the campaign's focus on linking Lula to corruption.

item.title: Marcola deixa a campanha do presidente Lula
item.description: Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, left the re-election campaign of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on Wednesday (August 5), following reports that he may have received payments from businesswoman and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who is allegedly a partner of Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes, known as 'Careca do INSS'. Marcola had served as Lula's chief of staff after the president's third-term inauguration and had recently joined the campaign team. His departure comes amid growing concerns over potential conflicts of interest and irregularities in campaign financing.

item.title: Ao lado de 6 mulheres, Flávio anuncia Alfredo Gaspar como vice
item.description: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) announced federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as his running mate in an event alongside six women. The decision came after Republicans and Progressistas chose neutrality, ruling out names like Daniella Marques (Republicanos) and Tereza Cristina (PP-MS). The report will be updated.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro anuncia Alfredo Gaspar, relator da comissão do INSS, como vice
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's presidential candidate, announced federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (AL) as his running mate for the 2026 elections. Gaspar serves as rapporteur of the mixed CPI on INSS, focusing on pension reform and public resource management. The alliance strengthens the conservative and pro-pension stance of the Bolsonaro campaign.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro define Alfredo Gaspar como vice em chapa puro-sangue
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) announced federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as his running mate in a pure-slate ticket for the 2026 presidential election. The announcement was made in Brasília on the final day of party conventions, ending weeks of speculation. Gaspar, a Northeasterner, stressed loyalty, fighting corruption and organized crime, while Valdemar Costa Neto confirmed the choice had been made six months prior.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro anuncia Alfredo Gaspar como vice na disputa à Presidência
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator from PL-RJ and presidential candidate, announced deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as his running mate for the 2026 presidential election. The announcement was made in Brasília, with thanks to the women considered for the ticket, including Tereza Cristina, Daniella Marques, Damares Alves, Bia Kicis, Renata Abreu, Michelle Bolsonaro, and Julia Zanatta.

item.title: Relator da CPMI do INSS é escolhido vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-RN) has been selected as the vice-presidential running mate for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in the 2026 presidential election. Gaspar gained national prominence as the rapporteur of the INSS Parliamentary Inquiry Committee (CPMI), which investigated alleged irregularities in the social security agency's management. Prior to this, he was preparing to run for a Senate seat in Rio Grande do Norte.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro anuncia deputado Alfredo Gaspar como vice na chapa dele à Presidência
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar as his vice-presidential candidate for the 2026 elections. Gaspar, a former prosecutor and rapporteur of the INSS CPI, was highlighted for his work in public security and defense of retirees. The announcement ends weeks of PL negotiations, after other parties chose to remain neutral in the presidential race.

item.title: Lula recebe assessor de Putin fora da agenda oficial
item.description: President Lula met with Nikolai Patrushev, Putin's advisor and head of Russia's Maritime Council, in an unofficial meeting to discuss bilateral cooperation and international security. Later that day, Lula called Putin to address the Ukraine war and bilateral trade, expressing disappointment with the UN Security Council's inability to resolve conflicts and emphasizing the need for dialogue among major powers. Patrushev also held meetings with Celso Amorim, Itamaraty's secretary-general, the Brazilian Navy commander, and officials from the Ministries of Ports and Airports and of Development, Industry, Commerce and Services, focusing on maritime, scientific, technological and defense collaboration.

item.title: Ex-chefe de gabinete decide deixar a campanha de Lula
item.description: Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, former chief of staff to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, decided to leave the coordination of Lula’s reelection campaign after it was revealed he took out a R$ 249,000 loan with businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, a transaction under investigation by the Federal Police. Marcola had left his position at the Planalto in July to join the campaign team, resuming the role he held in 2022. His departure is attributed to the need to focus on his personal defense, amid allegations of internal opposition within the campaign.

item.title: Ex-chefe de gabinete de Lula pede para deixar a campanha do petista
item.description: Former chief of staff to Lula, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, requested to leave the president's re-election campaign after revelations that he received payments from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who is under investigation by the Federal Police for alleged influence within the INSS under the PT administration. The move comes amid investigations into potential financial irregularities tied to the Lula government.

item.title: Mendonça cobra dados do governo Lula sobre gastos com publicidade para verificar se valores obedeceram teto
item.description: TSE Vice President André Mendonça has given the Lula government 10 days to provide data on advertising spending in the first half of 2026 to verify compliance with legal spending limits. The request partially grants a representation filed by the campaign of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), which alleges excessive institutional advertising. Mendonça emphasized the measure does not presuppose fraud and is intended solely to analyze the timing and nature of expenditures, without prejudging the final outcome.

item.title: Ex-chefe de gabinete de Lula pede para deixar campanha
item.description: Marco Aurélio Ribeiro, former chief of staff to President Lula and known as Marcola, decided to step down from Lula's campaign after reports emerged of a R$ 249,000 loan he took from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of the president's son, Lulinha. Although he stated he has repaid the debt and reaffirmed his commitment to ethics and transparency, Marcola said his departure is a political decision to avoid becoming a target of internal PT disputes and friendly fire, thereby protecting Lula's campaign. The PT is trying to persuade him to stay, but sources say he is considered irreconcilable.

item.title: Mendonça Filho une direita em Pernambuco e vai disputar o Senado
item.description: Mendonça Filho (PL-PE) announced his candidacy for the Brazilian Senate from Pernambuco, uniting conservative right-wing supporters after being left without space in União Brasil. He received endorsements from Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Anderson Ferreira (PL), and Gilson Machado (Pode), as well as the influential Coelho clan, and will be the sole slate for Flávio Bolsonaro in the state.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre se encontram na casa de Moraes após rompimento; senador fala em 'segredo'
item.description: Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre met at the residence of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes following months of estrangement, facilitated also by Justice Cristiano Zanin, to 'break the ice' and restore relations. The meeting, described as positive by aides, lasted two to three hours and focused on overcoming past grievances, with specific topics deferred until after the elections. Alcolumbre declined to elaborate, stating only that the discussion was a 'secret'.

item.title: Meio/Ideia: Lula preserva vantagem sobre Flávio Bolsonaro; concentração de votos nos dois cresce
item.description: Lula maintains an eight-point lead over Flávio Bolsonaro, with 43% and 35% voting intentions, respectively. The race is increasingly concentrated between the two, totaling 78% of the electorate, while alternative candidates remain weak. Despite their lead, both candidates exhibit high rejection rates, signaling a polarized electorate.
